why: This search is open. None of the results is a major reviewer or an authority. Every readable page is a small niche site working out runtimes from spec sheets, plus one Reddit post. Several of those sites (1, 2, 3, 8, 9) do give a 3-day chest-freezer answer by model, but none tested anything, and they don't agree on the numbers: they assume a freezer averages anywhere from 25 W to 40 W. None of the text gets to whether a solar panel would help. A focused page would stand out if it gave a 3-day pick, the panel size that keeps it going, current kit prices and tested codes.
